name: ai-trader
description: AI 原生期货单页客户端第一阶段工程

scripts.dev:runtime: AI_TRADER_RELOAD_ENABLED=1 uv run --project services/trader-runtime uvicorn trader_runtime.main:app --reload --reload-dir services/trader-runtime/src --timeout-graceful-shutdown 2 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: cd services/trader-runtime && uv run ruff check . ../tqkq-sidecar ../mt5-bridge && uv run mypy
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:sidecar && npm run test:workspace && npm run test:release
scripts.test:sidecar: uv run --project services/tqkq-sidecar --extra tqkq pytest services/tqkq-sidecar/tests -n 4 --durations=15 --durations-min=2
scripts.test:release: node --test scripts/check_desktop_release.test.mjs scripts/ci_select_checks.test.mjs scripts/sync_public_repo.test.mjs scripts/readback.test.mjs && npm run test:mt5-bridge
scripts.test:mt5-bridge: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python -m unittest discover -s services/mt5-bridge/tests
